paragraphs.text: In the twenty-ninth jubilee, in the first week, [1373 A.M.] in the beginning thereof Arpachshad took to himself a wife and her name was Rasu'eja, the daughter of Susan, the daughter of Elam, and she bare him a son in the third year in this week, [1375 A.M.] and he called his name And the son grew, and his father taught him writing, and he went to seek for himself a place where he might seize for And he found a writing which former (generations) had carved on the rock, and he read what was thereon, and he transcribed it and sinned owing to it; for it contained the teaching of the Watchers in accordance with which they used to observe the omens of the sun stars in all the signs of heaven.
paragraphs.original: ወበ፳ ወ፱ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ነሥአ፡ አርፋክስድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ራሱኤያ፡ ወለተ፡ ሱሰን፡ ወለተ፡ ኤላም፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በ፫ ዓመት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ኬናን፡
paragraphs.translit: waba20 wa9 ʾiyobēlwu qadāmāwi sabuʿ qadāmi naśʾa ʾarfāksəd lotu bəʾsita səmā rāsuʾēyā walata susan walata ʾēlām bəʾsita wawaladat lotu walda ba3 ʿāmat bazəntu sabuʿ wasamayo səmo kēnān

paragraphs.text: And he wrote it down and said nothing regarding it; for afraid to speak to Noah about it lest he should be angry with him on account of it. in the thirtieth jubilee, [1429 A.M.] in the second week, in the first year thereof, he took to himself a wife, and her name was Melka, the daughter of Madai, the son of Japheth, and in the fourth year [1432 A.M.] he begat a son, and called his name Shelah; for he said: 'Truly I have been sent.'
paragraphs.original: ወልሕቀ፡ ወልድ፡ ወመሐሮ፡ አቡሁ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ወሖረ፡ ከመ፡ የኀሥሥ፡ ሎቱ፡ መካነ፡ ኀበ፡ ይምስት፡ ቤተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወረከበ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ጥቅት፡ በውስተ፡ ኰኵሕ፡ ወአንበበ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ቦቱ፡ ወገለበቦ፡ ወአበሰ፡ ቦቱ፡
paragraphs.translit: waləḥqa waləd wamaḥaro ʾabuhu ṣəḥfata waḥora kama yaḫaśəś lotu makāna ḫaba yəmsət bēta lotu warakaba ṣəḥfata ṭəqət bawəsta kʷakʷəḥ waʾanbaba zaṣḥuf botu wagalababo waʾabasa botu

paragraphs.text: [And in the fourth year he was born], and Shelah grew up and took to himself a wife, and her name was Mu'ak, the daughter of Kesed, his father's brother, in the one and thirtieth jubilee, in the fifth week, in the first year And she bare him a son in the fifth year [1503 A.M.] thereof, and he called his name Eber: and he took unto himself a wife, and her name was 'Azûrâd, the daughter of Nebrod, in the thirty-second jubilee, in the seventh week, in the third year thereof. [1564 A.M.] And in the sixth year [1567 A.M.] thereof, she bare him son, and he called his name Peleg; for in the days when he was born the children of Noah began to divide the earth amongst themselves: for this reason he called his name Peleg.
paragraphs.original: ወአበሰ፡ እስመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ትጉሃን፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ኪነ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወወርኅ፡ ወከዋክብት፡ በውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትእምርት፡ ለሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: waʾabasa ʾəsma botu śərʿata təguhān zabotu kina ḍaḥay wawarəḫ wakawākbət bawəsta kʷəlu təʾəmrət lasamāy

paragraphs.text: divided (it) secretly amongst themselves, and told it to Noah. And it came to pass in the beginning of the thirty-third jubilee [1569 A.M.] that they divided the earth into three parts, for Shem and Ham and Japheth, according to the inheritance of each, in the first year in the first week, when one of us who had been sent, was with them.
paragraphs.original: ወጸሐፎ፡ ወኢዘንተ፡ ለመኑሂ፡ እስመ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ይብል፡ ለኖኅ፡ ለእመ፡ ይትመዐዕ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ በእንቲአሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: waṣaḥafo waʾizanta lamanuhi ʾəsma yəfarəh yəbəl lanoḫ laʾma yətmaʿaʿ lāʿlēhu baʾəntiʾahu

paragraphs.text: And he called his sons, and they drew nigh to him, they and their children, and he divided the earth into the lots, which his three sons were to take in possession, and they reached forth their hands, and took the writing out of the bosom of Noah, And there came forth on the writing as Shem's lot the middle of the earth which he should take as an inheritance for himself and for his sons for the generations of eternity, from the middle of the mountain range of Rafa, from the mouth of the water from the river Tina, and his portion goes towards the west through the midst of this river, and it extends till it reaches the water of the abysses, out of which this river goes forth and pours its waters into the sea Me'at, and this river flows into the great sea. And all that is towards the north is Japheth's, and all that is south belongs to Shem.
paragraphs.original: ወበ፴ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በራብዕ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዓመት፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ መልካ፡ ወለተ፡ ምሉሐድ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሳላ፡ እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ በአማን፡ ተፈነውኩ፡
paragraphs.translit: waba30 ʾiyobēlwu barābəʿ sabuʿ baqadāmāwi ʿāmat naśʾa lotu bəʾsita səmā malkā walata məluḥad bəʾsita wawaladat lotu walda barābəʿ ʿāmat lazəntu sabuʿ wasamayo səmo sālā ʾəsma yəbē baʾamān tafanawku

paragraphs.text: And it extends till it reaches Karaso: this is in the bosom of which looks towards the south. And his portion extends along the great sea, and it extends in a straight line till it reaches the west of the tongue which looks towards the south: for named the tongue of the Egyptian Sea.
paragraphs.original: ወወለደ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሳላ፡ ሄበር፡ በ፴ ወ፪ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በሳድስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wawalada lotu sālā hēbar ba30 wa2 ʾiyobēlwu basādəs sabuʿ baʿāmat qadāmāwi lazəntu sabuʿ

paragraphs.text: And it turns from here towards the south towards the mouth of the great sea on the shore of (its) waters, and it extends to the west to 'Afra, and it extends till it reaches the waters of the river Gihon, and to the south of the waters of banks of this river.
paragraphs.original: ወነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ አዙራድ፡ ወለተ፡ ኔብሮድ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ፋሌቅ፡ እስመ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ሎቱ፡ ተፈለጡ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ ምድረ፡
paragraphs.translit: wanaśʾa lotu bəʾsita səmā ʾazurād walata nēbrod bəʾsita wawaladat lotu walda barābəʿ ʿāmat lazəntu sabuʿ wasamayo səmo fālēq ʾəsma bamawāʿla lotu tafalaṭu daqiqa noḫ mədra

paragraphs.text: And it extends towards the east, till it reaches the Garden of Eden, to the south thereof, [to the south] and from the east of the whole land of Eden and of the whole east, it turns to the east and proceeds till it reaches the east of the mountain named Rafa, and it to the bank of the mouth of the river Tina.
paragraphs.original: ወጸውዐ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወከፈሎሙ፡ ምድረ፡ በዕፃ፡ በ፴ ወ፫ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡
paragraphs.translit: waṣawʿa noḫ ladaqiqu wakafalomu mədra baʿḍā ba30 wa3 ʾiyobēlwu baqadāmāwi sabuʿ baʿāmat qadāmāwi

paragraphs.text: This portion came forth by lot for Shem that they should possess it for ever unto his generations for evermore. rejoiced that this portion came forth for Shem and for his sons, and he remembered all that he had spoken with his mouth in prophecy; for he had said: 'Blessed be the Lord God of Shem And may the Lord dwell in the dwelling of Shem.'
paragraphs.original: ወወፅአ፡ ዕፁ፡ ለሴም፡ ቀዳሚ፡ መዐርግ፡ ዘበማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ ማእከለ፡ መነጸፍ፡ ለርእስከ፡ ኪደነ፡ መታክፍት፡ ለርእስከ፡ ኪደነ፡ ኤድኒ፡ ምስራቅ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ ወውስተ፡ ግዱፍ፡ ምድር፡ ምስራቅ፡ ኮነ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ኮነ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ ቅዱስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wawaḍʾa ʿəḍu lasēm qadāmi maʿarəg zabamāʾkala mədər māʾkala manaṣaf larʾəska kidana matākfət larʾəska kidana ʾēdni məsrāq safarka wawəsta gəduf mədər məsrāq kona qadāmi kona safarka qədus

paragraphs.text: And he knew that the Garden of Eden is the holy of holies, and the dwelling of the Lord, and Mount Sinai the centre of the desert, and Mount Zion -the centre of the navel of the earth: these three were created as holy places facing each other.
paragraphs.original: ወከደነ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወባረኮ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይትገበር፡ እግዚእ፡ መካነ፡ ለሴም፡ ለክብር፡ ማእከለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wakadana noḫ wabārako lasēm waybē buruk ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka sēm wayətgabar ʾəgziʾ makāna lasēm lakbər māʾkala mədər

paragraphs.text: And he blessed the God of gods, who word of the Lord into his mouth, and the Lord for evermore. And he knew that a blessed portion and a blessing had come to Shem and his sons unto the generations for ever -the whole land of Eden and the whole land of the Red Sea, and the whole land of the east and India, and on the Red Sea and the mountains thereof, and all the land of Bashan, and all the land of Lebanon and the islands of Kaftur, and all the mountains of Sanir and 'Amana, and the mountains of Asshur in the north, and all the land of Elam, Asshur, and Babel, and Susan and Ma'edai, and all the mountains of Ararat, and all the region beyond the sea, which is beyond the mountains of Asshur towards the north, a blessed and spacious land, and all that is in it is very good.
paragraphs.original: ወወፅአ፡ ጽሕፈት፡ ኀበ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኀበ፡ ሴም፡ ወወዘናሁ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኀደገ፡ ለሴም፡ ወለደቂቁ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤዶም፡ እስከ፡ ምድር፡ ምድር፡ ምድር፡ ኤዶም፡
paragraphs.translit: wawaḍʾa ṣəḥfat ḫaba noḫ ḫaba sēm wawazanāhu lanoḫ botu ḫadaga lasēm waladaqiqu latwəldomu laʿālam kʷəlo mədər ʾəmna mədra ʾēdom ʾəska mədər mədər mədər ʾēdom

paragraphs.text: And for Ham came forth the second portion, beyond the Gihon towards the south to the right of the Garden, and it extends towards the south and it extends to all the mountains of fire, and it extends towards the west to the sea of 'Atel and it extends towards the west till it reaches the sea of Ma'uk -that (sea) everything which is not destroyed descends.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ Σήμ μεσογαίᾳ τῆς γῆς ἣν λαμβάνει εἰς κληρονομίαν αὐτῷ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος, ἀπὸ τοῦ μέσου τοῦ ὄρους Ῥάφα, ἀπὸ ἐξόδου τοῦ Τίνα ποταμοῦ· καὶ προέρχεται ὁ κλῆρος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ δυσμὰς διὰ μέσου τοῦ ποταμοῦ τούτου, καὶ προέρχεται ἕως ὅτου ἀφικνεῖται εἰς τὴν Ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai exēlthen ho klēros tō Sēm mesogaia tēs gēs hēn lambanei eis klēronomian autō kai tois teknois autou eis tas geneas tou aiōnos, apo tou mesou tou orous Rhapha, apo exodou tou Tina potamou· kai proerchetai ho klēros autou epi dysmas dia mesou tou potamou toutou, kai proerchetai heōs hotou aphikneitai eis tēn Erythran thalassan.

paragraphs.text: And it goes forth towards the north to the limits of Gadir, and it goes forth to the coast of the waters of the sea to the waters of the great sea till it draws near to the river Gihon, and goes along the river Gihon till it reaches the right of the And this is the land which came forth for Ham as the portion which he was to for ever for himself and his sons unto their generations for ever.
paragraphs.original: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለሴም፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜን፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ግብጽ፡ ወይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ኤርትራ፡ ባሕር፡ እስከ፡ ይከይድ፡ ኀበ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ፀሐይ፡
paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu lasēm mangala samēn waykayəd mangala məśrāq wamāʾkala məśrāq wamāʾkala gəbəṣ waykayəd mangala məśrāq ʾērətrā bāḥər ʾəska yəkayəd ḫaba yəwaḍəʾ ḍaḥay

paragraphs.text: And for Japheth came forth the third portion beyond the river Tina to the north of the outflow of its waters, and it easterly to the whole region of Gog, and to all the country east thereof. northerly to the north, and it extends to the mountains of Qelt towards the north, and towards the Ma'uk, and it goes forth to the east of Gadir as far as the region of the waters of the And it extends until it approaches the west of Fara and it returns towards 'Aferag, and it extends easterly to the waters of the sea of Me'at.
paragraphs.original: ወሴም፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ይሐርሁ፡ ቦቱ፡ ለርእሶሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድር፡ ዘምሥራቅ፡ ኵሉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wasēm wawludu yəḥarhu botu larəʾsomu kʷəlo mədər zaməśrāq kʷəlu

paragraphs.text: And it extends to the region of the river Tina in a north-easterly direction until it approaches the boundary of its waters towards the mountain Rafa, round towards the north. This is the land which came forth for Japheth and his sons as the portion of his inheritance which he should possess for himself and his sons, for their generations for ever; five great islands, and a great land in the north.
paragraphs.original: ወይከይድ፡ ሎቱ፡ መካን፡ ሠናይ፡ ወክቡር፡ ወኵሉ፡ መካን፡ ዘይከይድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ምድር፡ ሠናይ፡ ወቡሩክ፡
paragraphs.translit: waykayəd lotu makān śanāy wakbur wakʷlu makān zaykayəd mangala məśrāq mədər śanāy waburuk

paragraphs.text: But it is cold, and the land of Ham is hot, and the land of Shem is neither hot nor cold, but it is of blended cold and heat.
